programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 402
programme.desc: Experterna åker till Hørning, där en präst och hennes familj behöver ett nytt hem. Idag hyr de ett litet radhus och nu vill de flytta.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 404
programme.desc: Ida och Rasmus drömmer om att byta sitt lilla hyreshus i Nørrebro mot en tegelvilla i Hillerød. Men de ångrar bittert att de har bett experterna om hjälp när de ser huset pengarna gick till.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 405
programme.desc: Anna Thora och Jonas har två små barn - och en dröm om att bo hos sina farföräldrar. Så nu letar experterna efter ett hus som rymmer två familjer, med plats för alla och deras behov.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 101
programme.desc: Värd Lisbeth Østergaard och de två experterna besöker Maiken och Michael i deras lilla lägenhet där de bor tillsammans med Michaels dotter. Snart blir de fyra och kan inte längre bo i lägenheten.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce  with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury Advancement, Camera Tracking & The International Space Station
programme.desc: Project Mercury Advances - America's first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. Camera Tracking - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch. The International Space Station - The building and operation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini, Venus Express, EMU & Deep Space Communication
programme.desc: Project Gemini Commences - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? Venus Express - The last days of ESA's Venus probe. EMU - NASA's Extravehicular Mobility Unit. Deep Space Communications - ESA's worldwide network of giant dishes.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity
programme.desc: This film features unexpected historical insights, cutting-edge science and exciting new experiments. From Einstein's Relativity to quantum mechanics, host Jim Al-Khalili explores one of the most extraordinary phenomena in our universe.

programme.title: Nirvana MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Nirvana's classic acoustic performance recorded at Sony Music Studios in New York City on November 18, 1993.

programme.title: Paul McCartney MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: MTV Unplugged,' world premiered this one hour performance with the legendary Paul McCartney. This performance was simulcast via the Global Satellite Network. Taped on January 25, 1991 at the Limehouse Studios in London.

programme.title: Alicia Keys MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Alicia Keys performs Unplugged at the Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Elton John MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In this MTV Unplugged Special, one of the most extravagant rockstars hits the stage. This is Elton John Unplugged.

programme.title: John Mellencamp MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This one-hour episode with beloved American rocker John Mellencamp was taped in Los Angeles in April of 1992, and features a medley of Mellencamp hits, past and present.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: Jennas självmordsstigma kommer på tapeten igen när en underlig stalker gör sig känd. Jenna börjar undra om hennes rykte gör att Matty inte kan se henne som flickvän.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna minglar med de elaka tjejerna när hon gör ett försök att platsa i Palos Verdes främsta välgörenhetsorganisation för mödrar och döttrar. Och det blir bara värre när hon stöter på Matty och Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jennas sextonårsdag är pinsam nog, men hon måste även ta tag i festens efterdyningar. När hon blir kuggad på uppkörningen undrar hon om hon nånsin kan få förhållandena med Matty och Tamara på rätt köl igen.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty bjuder ut Jenna på en riktig första dejt. Men det dröjer inte länge innan hon börjar ifrågasätta förhållandet med Matty igen.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik är i luften, och alla är entusiastiska över Winter Formal. Även om Jenna längtar efter den stora frågan, försöker hon att inte låta Mattys avslappnade attityd göra henne besviken.

programme.title: iCarly: Rockidolen

programme.title: iCarly: Sams Makeover
programme.desc: När Sam erkänner att hon är kär i en kille i skolan, visar Carly hur hon kan locka honom genom att bete sig mer tjejigt. Under tiden blir Spencer övertygad om att en tjej gillar honom på grund av hans smoking, så han börjar ha den på sig hela tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag dejtar en tuffing Del 1
programme.desc: När Carly dejtar en tuffing, försöker hon hålla deras relation hemlig för Spencer. Under tiden betalar Sam Freddie för att göra en hemsida där hon kan lägga ut alla sin favorit-äckel-filmer.

programme.title: iCarly: Återförening med Missy
programme.desc: När Carlys gamla kompis Missy flyttar tillbaks till Seattle, tror Sam att Missy försöker ersätta henne som Carlys bästa kompis.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag måste ha skåpet
programme.desc: När Sam och Freddie båda vinner en tävling för att få det bästa skåpet i skolan, tvingas de dela samma skåp. Under tiden ber Carly Spencer om att han ska ge henne lektioner i bild.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly-galan
